      abstract void showAchievement(String username, int objectiveNumber)

    • showError

      abstract void showError(String errorMessage)
      This method is used to notify the player when an error occurs. Specifically, this method should show an error when the response received by the server is an error message.
      Parameters:
      errorMessage - The message explaining the error
